thermal_summary_note: Rev 4.1 S1-A removes the entire bottom heatsink, CNC aluminum pedestal, and gap pad. At 30 C horizontal 8-ALL Nominal (0.550 W PCB), Tj_UV = 60.5 C (+39.5 C margin), T_pcb = 52.8 C, Tj_U1 = 63.4 C (+61.6 C margin). Even at 30 C horizontal 0%-WPE DS-100% (0.797 W PCB), Tj_UV = 86.2 C (+13.8 C margin) and T_pcb = 67.6 C (< 75 C PETG limit). At 35 C horizontal real-world 8-ALL Nominal, Tj_UV = 65.4 C and T_pcb = 57.6 C (all PASS).
